title: Security software and Daedalus

summary.text: Daedalus warns that antivirus or antimalware software could treat the thousands of network requests it makes when the Off-chain metadata server (SMASH) is not used as malicious behavior.

problem.text: A user suspects that antivirus, antimalware or firewall software interferes with Daedalus.

symptoms.text: Daedalus fails to connect or sync and security software is installed.

user_phrases.text: Should I turn off my firewall for Daedalus?

daedalus.notes: Behavior read from the Daedalus 11.6.0 release notes and the 11.6.0 tag source. Check a newer release before relying on it for a later version.

causes.claim: The available evidence does not establish one cause.

diagnostics.action: Daedalus Diagnostics shows whether the Cardano node is responding and syncing.

resolutions.action: If Daedalus offers Download logs, download your logs.
Open a support case in the support portal, name your security software and attach the logs.

expected_outcome.text: The user follows the behavior the cited sources describe and knows where to ask for help if it does not resolve the problem.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, private keys or spending passwords.
Do not delete, reset or move wallet data using generic instructions.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

evidence.rationale: The only official statement found is the stake pool setting warning; no official source ties other security software behavior to a Daedalus version or platform.

faq.reason: Common support topic with a short answer that every cited source supports.
